name: GD Optimizer
description: Rendering optimizations for Geometry Dash with particle suppression and an FPS/frame-time monitor.

show-fps.name: FPS Monitor
show-fps.description: Show average FPS and frame time during a level.

potato-mode.name: Potato Mode
potato-mode.description: Skip drawing all particle systems. This hides particle visuals; particle simulation may still use CPU.

reduce-particles.name: Reduce Particles
reduce-particles.description: Skip drawing particle systems with 12 or more active particles. Less aggressive than Potato Mode.
